title: Define the Mez Systems Wings and mark contract
objective: Turn the canonical two-path Wings into a bounded Mez Systems mark system covering holdco lockup, standalone mark, product-core mark, rare gradient-mask expression, colour, clear space, minimum size, responsive substitution and export boundaries without redrawing the asset or inventing a separate corporate identity.

included: canonical two-path Wings asset and checksum
Mez Systems holdco lockup and standalone mark roles
charcoal light-surface and white inverse states
white product-core mark inherited from disc and sphere
clear space, minimum size and compact responsive substitution
light, off-white, dark, print/export and failure behaviour
excluded: app icon, favicon, roundel, monoline or keyline families
product cards, trading cards, stacks or homepage composition

acceptance: one schema-validated source defines geometry, roles, lockup, colour, clear space, minimum size, gradient-mask and export rules
canonical Wings, disc, sphere, renderer and foundations remain unchanged
candidate status and promotion authority are explicit
the page states exactly which mark decisions are under review
holdco, standalone, product-core and gradient-mask roles are visibly distinct
light, off-white, dark, compact, minimum-size and failure states are visible
human verdict can be recorded without changing canonical inputs

verification.passCondition: all mark states use the unchanged canonical two-path Wings asset
holdco, standalone, product-core and exceptional gradient-mask roles cannot be confused
clear space, 24px minimum Wings height and compact substitution remain legible
ordinary marks use only #2E2E2E or white and no separate corporate hue is introduced
gradient Wings reduce to an exact static mask for reduced motion and runtime failure
Olli approves the Wings and mark contract for promotion

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Does this give Mez Systems one restrained, usable mark hierarchy—shared Wings, a clear holdco lockup, white product marks and one rare gradient expression—without inventing another brand?

stopConditions: a build redraws or mutates the canonical Wings SVG
the candidate introduces a separate Mez Systems corporate hue
ordinary holdco or product marks become animated gradient Wings
archive-only app icon, roundel, monoline or keyline variants are promoted
the task expands into cards, stacks, homepage, Figma or consumer work
notes: The canonical colour foundation supersedes the archive's #0D0D0D mark recommendation with #2E2E2E.
Treat the shared Wings as inherited Mez identity; Mez Systems does not need a second symbol or corporate colour.
The gradient Wings mask is an exceptional identity or motion state, never the ordinary product mark.
